records.label: Familial pheochromocytoma family
records.segregation: Linkage to 2cen and 16p13 (multipoint LOD 2.97 each; two-locus LOD 5.16)
quotes: We describe here a familial pheochromocytoma syndrome consistent with digenic inheritance identified through a combination of global genomics strategies.
Allele-specific loss of heterozygosity (LOH) was detected only at the chromosome 2 locus in all tumors from this family, consistent with a tumor suppressor gene.

records.label: FP/TMEM127 germline mutation carriers (20 independent families)
quotes: We identified 19 potentially pathogenic FP/TMEM127 germline mutations in 20 independent families, but no large deletions were detected.
All mutation carriers had adrenal tumors, including 7 bilateral (P = 2.7 × 10(-4)) and/or with familial disease (5 of 20 samples; P = .005).
Malignancy was seen in 1 mutation carrier (5%).
records.genotype_reason: single heterozygous variant; mode as stated for the family

records.label: Two unrelated Japanese patients with bilateral pheochromocytoma

phenotypes.text: loss of heterozygosity of 2q in tumour

quotes: two unrelated patients (2·7%) with bilateral adrenal pheochromocytoma were found to have an identical germline TMEM127 mutation (c.116_119delTGTC, p.Ile41ArgfsX39) associated with 2q deletion loss of heterozygosity

records.label: Six-generation family carrying TMEM127 c.410-2A>C
records.onset: symptoms started at 29 years (range, 10-55 y); median age at diagnosis 43 years

phenotypes.text: adrenomedullary nodules less than 10 mm (nodular adrenomedullary hyperplasia)

records.segregation: 47 of 151 relatives carried the mutation; 11 of 34 carriers with clinical data developed pheochromocytoma
quotes: Forty seven individuals carried the c.410-2A>C TMEM127 mutation. Clinical data were obtained from 34 TMEM127-mutation carriers followed up for 8.7 ± 8.1 years (range, 1-20 y). Pheochromocytoma was diagnosed in 11 carriers (32%) at a median age of 43 years.

Tumors were multicentric in five (45%) and bilateral in five (45%) patients. Six patients (54%) had at least one adrenomedullary nodule less than 10 mm. No paragangliomas, distant metastases, or other manifestations were detected.
In nine patients, symptoms started at 29 years (range, 10-55 y) and two cases were asymptomatic.
records.genotype_reason: single heterozygous variant; mode as stated for the family

records.label: SDHA mutation carriers
quotes: 58 (6.0%) carried germline mutations of interest, including 29 SDHA, 20 TMEM127, 8 MAX, and 1 SDHAF2

SDHA disease occurred as early as 8 years of age. Extra-adrenal tumors occurred in 28 mutation carriers (48%) and in 23 of 29 SDHA mutation carriers (79%), particularly with head and neck paraganglioma.

records.label: 61-year-old female patient

phenotypes.hpo_label: Increased circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 concentration

quotes: A 61-year-old female patient presented with pressure in the left neck, deepening of the voice and exertional dyspnoea existing for about half a year. At the same time, paroxysmal hypertensive crisis with systolic blood pressure up to 240 mmHg with headache, flushing and tightness in the chest occurred.
This resulted in the detection of a heterozygous mutation in the TMEM127 gene on intron 2 (c.245-10C>G), which was a novel variant at that time
The identified TMEM127 variant (c.245-10C>G) is a variant of uncertain significance according to ACMG criteria

records.label: Cohort of 110 index patients with germline TMEM127 variants

phenotypes.text: Elevated epinephrine with or without norepinephrine

quotes: The cohort comprised 110 index patients (111 variants) with a mean age of 45 years (range, 21-84 years). Females were predominant (76 vs 34, P < .001).
Most patients had PHEO (n = 94; 85.5%), although PGL (n = 10; 9%) and renal cell carcinoma (RCC, n = 6; 5.4%) were also detected, either alone or in combination with PHEO.
One-third of the cases had multiple tumors, and known family history was reported in 15.4%. Metastatic PHEO/PGL was rare (2.8%).
records.genotype_reason: single heterozygous variant; mode as stated for the family

records.label: 65-year-old woman

phenotypes.text: no recurrence after 5 years following bilateral adrenalectomy

quotes: We report a 65 year old woman with hypertension, bilateral adrenal nodules found in the CT scan and elevated urinary metanephrines. Her genetic testing showed a c.117_120delGTCT TMEM127 gene mutation.
After five years of follow up, no recurrence of the disease has been recorded.

notes.statement: Delgado et al. (2022) reported that a woman with bilateral pheochromocytoma and a TMEM127 mutation underwent laparoscopic bilateral adrenalectomy, with no recurrence recorded after 5 years of follow-up.
quotes: She was subjected to a laparoscopic bilateral adrenal excision. After five years of follow up, no recurrence of the disease has been recorded.

notes.statement: Stütz et al. (2020) classified the TMEM127 c.245-10C>G variant as of uncertain significance (PM2, BP4). Because it lies between the known variants c.245-7 and c.245-12, they suggested it might disrupt the consensus splice site, but they noted that abnormal splicing had not been shown experimentally. The same variant had also been found in a patient with breast cancer.
quotes: The identified TMEM127 variant (c.245-10C>G) is a variant of uncertain significance according to ACMG criteria (; PM2, as variant is not found in gnomAD database, and BP4, based on in silicio prediction tools).
Its location between the other known variants c.245-7 (splice region) and c.245-12 (intron) suggests the possibility of a relevant variant with disruption of the consensus splice site.

notes.statement: Armaiz-Pena et al. (2021) found that, although nontruncating TMEM127 variants were less frequent than truncating variants overall, they predominated in non-pheochromocytoma presentations (36% PHEO-only vs 69% other) and clustered disproportionately within transmembrane regions, underscoring the relevance of these domains for TMEM127 function.
quotes: Although nontruncating variants were less frequent than truncating changes overall, they were predominant in non-PHEO clinical presentations (36% PHEO-only vs 69% other, P < .001) and clustered disproportionately within transmembrane regions (P < .01), underscoring the relevance of these domains for TMEM127 function.

notes.statement: Armaiz-Pena et al. (2021) concluded that patients with TMEM127 variants often resemble sporadic nonmetastatic pheochromocytomas; paraganglioma and renal cell carcinoma may also co-occur, although their causal link required further evaluation. Epinephrine alone or with norepinephrine accounted for 82% of tumor catecholamine profiles.
quotes: Patients with TMEM127 variants often resemble sporadic nonmetastatic PHEOs. PGL and RCC may also co-occur, although their causal link requires further evaluation.
Epinephrine alone, or combined with norepinephrine, accounted for 82% of the catecholamine profiles of PHEO/PGLs.

notes.statement: Armaiz-Pena et al. (2021) found that most TMEM127 variants (63) occurred only once while 13 were recurrent (2-12 times), and proposed classifying variants into 4 groups based on mutation type, localization, and predicted disruption to predict pathogenicity and assist carrier surveillance.
quotes: Most variants (n = 63) occurred only once and 13 were recurrent (2-12 times).
Integration of clinical and previous experimental data supported classification of variants into 4 groups based on mutation type, localization, and predicted disruption.

notes.statement: Bausch et al. (2017) analyzed 972 unrelated registrants of the European-American-Asian Pheochromocytoma-Paraganglioma Registry who had no mutations in the classic PPGL genes. They found that 58 (6.0%) carried germline mutations in SDHA (29), TMEM127 (20), MAX (8) or SDHAF2 (1). Of these 58 patients, 53 (91%) had familial, multiple, extra-adrenal and/or malignant tumors and/or were younger than 40 years.
quotes: Of 972 unrelated registrants without mutations in the classic pheochromocytoma- and paraganglioma-associated genes
58 (6.0%) carried germline mutations of interest, including 29 SDHA, 20 TMEM127, 8 MAX, and 1 SDHAF2
Fifty-three of 58 patients (91%) had familial, multiple, extra-adrenal, and/or malignant tumors and/or were younger than 40 years.

notes.statement: Bausch et al. (2017) found that 7 of 63 (11%) pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas in carriers of SDHA and TMEM127 mutations were malignant. Extra-adrenal tumors occurred in 28 (48%) of the mutation carriers.
quotes: Newly uncovered are 7 of 63 (11%) malignant pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas in SDHA and TMEM127 disease.
Extra-adrenal tumors occurred in 28 mutation carriers (48%)

notes.statement: Bausch et al. (2017) estimated the penetrance in SDHA mutation carriers at 39% by age 40 years. Penetrance was significantly higher in index patients (45%) than in relatives carrying the mutation (13%; P less than 0.001).
quotes: Penetrance in the largest subset, SDHA carriers, was 39% at 40 years of age and is statistically different in index patients (45%) vs mutation-carrying relatives (13%; P < .001).

notes.statement: Bausch et al. (2017) recommended genetic testing of SDHA, TMEM127, MAX and SDHAF2 in clinically high-risk patients who are negative for mutations in the classic genes. They also stated that gene-specific prevention and/or early detection requires regular, systematic whole-body investigation.
quotes: Genetic testing is recommended in patients at clinically high risk if the classic genes are mutation negative. Gene-specific prevention and/or early detection requires regular, systematic whole-body investigation.

notes.statement: Toledo et al. (2015) found that the cumulative penetrance of pheochromocytoma in carriers of a TMEM127 mutation was 0% at 0 to 20 years, 3% at 21 to 30 years, 15% at 31 to 40 years, 24% at 41 to 50 years, and 32% at 51 to 65 years. The youngest patient was diagnosed at 22 years, and the earliest symptoms were reported at age 10.
quotes: Cumulative penetrance of pheochromocytoma was 0% at 0-20 years, 3% at 21-30 years, 15% at 31-40 years, 24% at 41-50 years, and 32% at 51-65 years. The youngest case was diagnosed at 22 years and the earliest symptoms were reported at age 10.

notes.statement: Toledo et al. (2015) concluded that multicentric tumors, nodular adrenomedullary hyperplasia, and symptoms starting more than a decade before diagnosis were novel findings in TMEM127-related pheochromocytoma.
quotes: Tumor multicentricity, nodular adrenomedullary hyperplasia, and the occurrence of symptoms more than a decade earlier than the age at diagnosis are novel findings in TMEM127-related PHEO.

notes.statement: Toledo et al. (2015) recommended offering TMEM127 genetic testing to at-risk individuals at age 22 years. They also recommended annual clinical surveillance for mutation carriers.
quotes: We thus recommend that TMEM127 genetic testing should be offered to at-risk individuals at age 22 years and mutation carriers should undergo clinical surveillance annually.

notes.statement: Takeichi et al. (2012) sequenced TMEM127 in 74 unrelated Japanese patients with pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma who tested negative for RET, VHL, SDHB and SDHD mutations. They found germline TMEM127 mutations in 2 patients (2.7%). None of 114 ethnically matched healthy controls carried the deletion.
quotes: 74 unrelated patients with pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma who tested negative for mutations and deletions in RET, VHL, SDHB and SDHD were recruited through a multi-institutional collaborative effort in Japan
We also determined that none of the 114 normal healthy controls had this deletion mutation.

notes.statement: Takeichi et al. (2012) concluded that this was the first report of a pathologic role for TMEM127 mutation in pheochromocytoma in an Asian population. They noted that the same c.116_119delTGTC mutation had been reported before in a Brazilian case. They stated that the prevalence and phenotype appeared similar to those in previous studies, although their surveillance was limited.
quotes: This is the first report showing that TMEM127 mutation plays a pathological role in pheochromocytoma in an Asian population. Although our surveillance is limited, the prevalence and the phenotype of this gene mutation appear to be similar to those reported in previous studies.

notes.statement: Yao et al. (2010) sequenced FP/TMEM127 in 990 individuals with pheochromocytoma and/or paraganglioma, including 898 previously unreported cases without mutations in other susceptibility genes, and identified 19 potentially pathogenic germline mutations in 20 independent families. No large deletions were detected in 545 samples screened by multiplex PCR.
quotes: We sequenced the FP/TMEM127 gene in 990 individuals with pheochromocytomas and/or paragangliomas, including 898 previously unreported cases without mutations in other susceptibility genes from 8 independent worldwide referral centers between January 2009 and June 2010.
We identified 19 potentially pathogenic FP/TMEM127 germline mutations in 20 independent families, but no large deletions were detected.

notes.statement: Yao et al. (2010) found that germline TMEM127 mutations were associated with pheochromocytoma but not paraganglioma. Median age at onset in mutation carriers was similar to that of patients without a mutation (41.5 vs 45 years), and the most common presentation was a single benign adrenal tumor in patients older than 40 years, an age group frequently excluded from genetic screening algorithms.
quotes: The median age at disease onset in the FP/TMEM127 mutation group was similar to that of patients without a mutation (41.5 vs 45 years, respectively; P = .54). The most common presentation was that of a single benign adrenal tumor in patients older than 40 years.
Germline mutations of FP/TMEM127 were associated with pheochromocytoma but not paraganglioma and occurred in an age group frequently excluded from genetic screening algorithms.

notes.statement: Yao et al. (2010) found by confocal microscopy that 5 novel TMEM127 mutant proteins expressed in cell lines showed diffuse localization, in contrast with the discrete multiorganelle distribution of wild-type TMEM127, indicating that disease-associated mutations disrupt intracellular distribution of the protein.
quotes: Expression of 5 novel FP/TMEM127 mutations in cell lines revealed diffuse localization of the mutant proteins in contrast with the discrete multiorganelle distribution of wild-type TMEM127.
Disease-associated mutations disrupt intracellular distribution of the FP/TMEM127 protein.

notes.statement: In a family with pheochromocytoma, Dahia et al. (2005) found identical multipoint LOD scores of 2.97 for loci at chromosome 2cen and 16p13. Two-locus parametric linkage analysis gave a maximum LOD score of 5.16 under a double recessive multiplicative model, suggesting that both loci are required for disease.
quotes: Multipoint parametric linkage analysis revealed identical LOD scores of 2.97 for chromosome 2cen and 16p13 loci.
A two-locus parametric linkage analysis produced maximum LOD score of 5.16 under a double recessive multiplicative model, suggesting that both loci are required to develop the disease.

notes.statement: Dahia et al. (2005) found 4 more pheochromocytomas with a similar genetic pattern by transcription profiling, which helped refine the chromosome 2 locus. High-density SNP array LOH mapping found LOH within the chromosome 2 region in 18 of 62 pheochromocytomas, narrowing the locus to less than 2 cM.
quotes: Four additional pheochromocytomas with a similar genetic pattern were identified through transcription profiling and helped refine the chromosome 2 locus.

High-density LOH mapping with single nucleotide polymorphism-based array identified a total of 18 of 62 pheochromocytomas with LOH within the chromosome 2 region, which further narrowed down the locus to <2 cM.

notes.statement: Dahia et al. (2005) concluded that the familial pheochromocytoma syndrome followed a recessive digenic trait, adding to the genetic heterogeneity of these tumors.
quotes: This finding provides evidence for two novel susceptibility loci for pheochromocytoma and adds a recessive digenic trait to the increasingly broad genetic heterogeneity of these tumors.
